summary: A named sales team and authorised agent status are strengths, but conflicting licence labels and an empty section appear to cost you buyer trust.

findings.problem: The page appears to show no contact form, only phone, WhatsApp, email and a Book video call link, and many competing calls to action with none emphasised.
findings.cost: Buyers face too many choices and no simple form.

findings.problem: The licence number 20250000451516 appears under two regulator names, ADREC and ADM, and the WhatsApp number appears to use a +971 4 code while the offices are in Abu Dhabi.
findings.cost: Mismatched licence and phone details make a buyer doubt the agency.
findings.fix: One verified licence line and correct numbers.

findings.problem: The Curated Collection section appears to have a heading and a link but no projects, and Find Property in Abu Dhabi appears twice.
findings.cost: Empty and repeated sections look unfinished.
findings.fix: Filled sections and a clean layout.

findings.problem: The page appears to show Client Reviews in the footer but no testimonials, the stats AED 142B+ and 97 nationalities have no source, and labels such as Off-PlanBuy run together.
findings.cost: No proof and typos lose luxury buyers.
findings.fix: Real reviews, sourced figures and clean copy.

redesign: One clear enquiry form and WhatsApp.
Reviews, sourced stats and clean copy.
